_note: GST rule pack (I5): when a business must report its invoices to the e-invoice portal (IRN), and how soon.

explain.en: From 1 August 2023 a business whose aggregate turnover exceeded ₹5 crore in any financial year since 2017-18 must issue e-invoices (an IRN from the portal) for B2B supplies; SEZ units, banks, insurers, transporters, passenger transport and cinema admissions are exempt.
explain.hi-Latn: 1 August 2023 se, 2017-18 ke baad kisi bhi saal ₹5 crore se zyada turnover hua ho to B2B bill e-invoice portal par register karna zaroori hai (IRN); SEZ unit, bank, insurance, transporter, passenger transport, cinema chhoot.

explain.en: From 1 April 2025 a business with turnover of ₹10 crore or more must report an invoice to the e-invoice portal within 30 days of its date; later it is refused.
explain.hi-Latn: 1 April 2025 se ₹10 crore ya zyada turnover wali dukaan ko bill ke 30 din ke andar e-invoice portal par dena hoga; baad mein nahi hota.
